entities.name: Mariano Nicolás Valcárcel
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mariano Nicolás Valcárcel was a Peruvian lawyer and politician. He was born in Arequipa, Peru. He served as foreign minister (1882–1883) and minister of the interior (1890–1891) in the Government of Peru. He was Prime Minister of Peru. He served in the Chamber of Deputies of Peru and was elected as its president three times.
